summary: You can only migrate between installation types of the same AAP version (for example RPM 2.6 to containerized 2.6, not RPM 2.4 to containerized 2.6). Workflow: prepare source, export, create and verify the artifact, prepare target, import, reconcile, validate.
questions: Can I migrate from AAP 2.4 RPM to 2.6 containerized?
What are the steps of an AAP migration?
Do source and target need the same AAP version?
